desc: Derive structure: parities forced by first element; counts `o!*e!` (n odd) or `2*o!*e!` (n even); completions of a prefix = `(#rem odds)! * (#rem evens)!`; uniform block size per step enables factorial-number-system digit extraction.
**Implement `Solution.permute`** (factorials, total count & early `[]`, greedy per-position candidate selection with uniform block size, special handling of position 0 for even `n`).

**Test/verify:** examples `(4,6)->[3,4,1,2]`, `(3,2)->[3,2,1]`, `(2,3)->[]`, `n=1` cases; even-`n` position-0 block equality (`o!*(e-1)! == (o-1)!*e!` when `o==e`) confirms lexicographic interleaving is handled; bigint factorials safe for `n=100`, O(n²) runtime.
